import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/cameras.csv')

# Set style
plt.style.use('seaborn-v0_8-darkgrid')
sns.set_palette("husl")

# Create figure with subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(18, 12))

# 1. Price distribution by sensor type (boxplot)
ax1 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 1)
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='sensor_type', y='price_usd', ax=ax1)
ax1.set_title('Camera Price Distribution by Sensor Type', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Sensor Type', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=10)
ax1.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 2. Megapixels vs Price with brand differentiation (scatter plot)
ax2 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 2)
top_brands = df['brand'].value_counts().nlargest(5).index
df_top_brands = df[df['brand'].isin(top_brands)]
scatter = ax2.scatter(df_top_brands['megapixels'], df_top_brands['price_usd'], 
                     c=df_top_brands['model_year'], cmap='viridis', 
                     alpha=0.6, s=df_top_brands['weight_grams']/20)
ax2.set_title('Megapixels vs Price (Colored by Year, Sized by Weight)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Megapixels', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=10)
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax2)
cbar.set_label('Model Year', fontsize=9)

# 3. Average price by body type (bar plot)
ax3 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 3)
price_by_body = df.groupby('body_type')['price_usd'].mean().sort_values(ascending=False)
bars = ax3.bar(price_by_body.index, price_by_body.values)
ax3.set_title('Average Price by Body Type', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('Body Type', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_ylabel('Average Price (USD)', fontsize=10)
ax3.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
for bar in bars:
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax3.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + 50,
             f'${height:,.0f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=8)

# 4. 4K video capability distribution (pie chart)
ax4 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 4)
video_counts = df['has_video_4k'].value_counts()
labels = ['No 4K Video', 'Has 4K Video']
colors = ['#ff9999', '#66b3ff']
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax4.pie(video_counts.values, labels=labels, colors=colors, autopct='%1.1f%%',
                                   startangle=90, textprops={'fontsize': 10})
ax4.set_title('Distribution of 4K Video Capability', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('white')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')

# 5. Weight distribution by body type (violin plot)
ax5 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 5)
sns.violinplot(data=df, x='body_type', y='weight_grams', ax=ax5, inner='quartile')
ax5.set_title('Weight Distribution by Body Type', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_xlabel('Body Type', fontsize=10)
ax5.set_ylabel('Weight (grams)', fontsize=10)
ax5.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 6. Correlation heatmap of numerical features
ax6 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 6)
numerical_cols = ['model_year', 'megapixels', 'max_iso', 'weight_grams', 'price_usd', 'has_video_4k']
corr_matrix = df[numerical_cols].corr()
mask = np.triu(np.ones_like(corr_matrix, dtype=bool))
heatmap = sns.heatmap(corr_matrix, mask=mask, annot=True, fmt='.2f', cmap='coolwarm',
                     center=0, square=True, linewidths=1, cbar_kws={"shrink": 0.8}, ax=ax6)
ax6.set_title('Correlation Heatmap of Numerical Features', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# Adjust layout and add main title
plt.suptitle('Digital Camera Market Analysis: Specifications and Pricing Trends', 
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150, facecolor='white')
plt.close()
